prompt:
3D rendered character illustration. Soft matte clay-like surfaces with absolutely no gloss, no plastic shine, no specular highlights. Gentle diffuse studio lighting from the upper left with soft ambient occlusion contact shadows. Strongly stylised chunky proportions like a modern 3D mascot: thick simplified limbs, large simplified hands and shoes, soft rounded volumes, minimal facial detail, closer to a collectible vinyl figure than to a realistic person. Adult proportions, never a child, never chibi, never big-headed. Calm focused expression, never euphoric. No outlines, no cel shading, no line art.
PALETTE. Environment, props and background are restricted to: warm cream #F5F2E9, deep green #245B46, mid green #4F8B72, pale sage #E6EEE9, warm off-white #FFFDF8, warm near-black #1B1D1A, muted gold #B8862D. Clothing may additionally use muted clay #B5654A, slate blue #5A6F80 and sand #D8CDB8, and nothing else. Skin and hair are natural.
Forbidden: any text, letter, number, word or logo anywhere in the image; gradient background; neon; purple; magenta; photorealism; glossy plastic; rim light; lens flare.
Flat solid #F5F2E9 background with nothing on it. Single subject, whole subject fully inside the frame with generous empty margin on all four sides.

SCENE: Bia — an adult woman around 32 with pale freckled skin and shoulder-length curly RED hair, wearing a muted clay #B5654A blazer over a cream blouse and sand trousers. She walks forward and upward, already stepping onto the second of five chunky matte steps built from deep green blocks that climb away to her right and out of frame. Mid-stride, one large simplified hand swinging, looking ahead and slightly up. Unhurried and certain, not triumphant, not jumping, not celebrating. Side three quarter view, full body.
